purpose.summary: This program sends an email via the Windows MAPI (Simple MAPI / MAPI32.DLL) interface. It logs on to a MAPI session, resolves the recipient, constructs a MapiMessage structure (subject, body, attachments, originator, recipient), sends the message, then logs off and shuts down. It is designed to be called as a subprogram from a larger ACUCOBOL-GT application.

verdict.notes: Source is truncated at 16000 chars (of 28650 bytes); the PROCEDURE DIVISION is only partially visible but enough is shown to confirm purpose and dialect. The pipe-delimited inline comments (| ULONG, | LPTSTR) are an unusual documentation convention mapping COBOL fields to their C-struct counterparts. The program is clearly production-quality ACUCOBOL-GT code targeting Win32 MAPI email sending.
